_comment: Project-shared MCP server registrations. Empty by default — every adopter wires the servers they actually use during company-init or after. The github MCP server (used by CSO for branch-protection checks and by COO for pr-spec execution) is the most common addition; see README.md § 'Adding the github MCP server' for the exact JSON snippet plus the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env-var setup. Pre-v0.6.4 this file shipped with github pre-registered, which produced a 'missing environment variable' warning at every fresh adopter's first claude invocation — first-impression UX cost. v0.6.4 ships empty here; adopters add servers explicitly.
